plan.summary: Onboarding Wizard frontend page consuming GET /api/v1/onboarding/status API (PKT-2). Vertical stepper layout with 7 steps, progress bar, step detail panel, and confetti celebration on 100% completion.
plan.q_intent: PKT-2 API'sini tuketen Dashboard onboarding wizard sayfasi. Tenant kurulum ilerlemesini gosterip yonlendirsin.
plan.interview_notes: Q chose vertical stepper layout + confetti on completion. No new dependencies. Pure frontend — no backend changes.

files_changed.change: Full wizard page: vertical stepper, step detail panel, confetti overlay, 7-step metadata
Added Kurulum Sihirbazi nav item with Rocket icon

build.command: npx vite build + dotnet build InvektoServis.sln

verification_questions.question: Does the page handle loading, error, and empty states gracefully without crashing?
Are the step keys in STEP_META consistent with the backend OnboardingStatusService step keys?
Does the action_url navigation correctly strip the /app prefix before calling useNavigate?

intentional_exclusions: No backend code changes — pure frontend consuming existing PKT-2 API

try_catch_locations: OnboardingWizardPage.tsx: fetchStatus try/catch with error state
user_facing_errors: Error message displayed in red banner on fetch failure
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: fetchStatus catches all errors and displays them in the UI. No silent failures.
